codeReview.summary: The commit delivers the requested eval framework in internal/eval with suite/test-case types, suite runner, metrics computation, SQLite persistence (eval_results), baseline save/compare + regression detection, built-in suites (basic/tool_choice/delegation), JSON custom-suite loading from .openclawssy/eval, and focused tests across runner/metrics/store/baseline/suites. issues.description: runCase directly executes Setup/Run/Cleanup callbacks without panic recovery, so a panic in any test callback can abort the entire suite execution instead of being captured as a failed case result.
